sentences.text:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Pradeep Kumar Srivastava
-----
 For the Petitioner : Mr. Anurag Kashyap, Advocate
 For the State : Mr. Shree Prakash Jha, Addl.P.P

For the O.P. No.2 : Mr. J.N. Upadhyay, Advocate  .....
 Order No.06/ Dated:17.08.2023  1. Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. Apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 232 of 2022 instituted under Sections 498A/ 406/ 420/ 120B/ 500/386/ 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act and under Sections 3 to 6 of Prevention of Witch (Daain) Practices Act, 2001 and later on cognizance was taken under Sections 498A/ 323 of the Indian Penal Code,
the petitioner has moved to this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.
3. As per complaint case, allegation against the petitioner is that he solemnized marriage with the complainant on 23.04.2021 at Birsanagar Temple.

Several household articles and cash of Rs.
5,00,000/- were presented at the time of marriage.
After sometime, complainant was called as daain and illiterate by the petitioner and his family members.
It is also alleged that petitioner has illicit relationship with one Nikki Kaur.

It is also alleged that accused persons always pressurized the complainant to bring some money from her parental home in order to remove bad soul from the complainant and also ousted from her matrimonial home stanching her stridhan and valuables.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence at all rather he has been falsely implicated in this case.
It is submitted that petitioner is the husband.
Matter was referred to the Mediation Centre, JHALSA but no settlement could be arrived at between the parties.
Although, petitioner is ready to live with his wife with dignity and honor but she is not accompanying and joining the matrimonial home.
There are general and omnibus allegation against the petitioner and this case has been lodged only on the basis of suspicion of character of the petitioner.
It is submitted that it is a complainant case and only summons has been issued against the petitioner.

It is lastly submitted that the petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the trial of the case and also abide by all terms and conditions which may be Prabhat Chaubey @ P. Chaubey vs The State Of Jharkhand on 17 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/54897165/
1 imposed in the matter of granting anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

entities.text: Prabhat Chaubey @ P. Chaubey vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Hence, the petitioner may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.

5. Learned Addl.P.P appearing for the State assisted with learned counsel for the complainant opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner and submitted that there are direct and specific allegation against the petitioner about cruel treatment with victim/informant and ousting from matrimonial home without any reasonable cause, hence, petitioner does not deserve anticipatory bail.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of allegation coupled with materials on record, counter case against the petitioner and also in view of the fact that there is matrimonial discord between the parties and no possibility of any settlement at present and no valid justification for his custodial trail, I am inclined to grant privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to surrender in the Court below within four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrendering, he will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate, Jamshedpur in connection with Complaint Case No.
232 of 2022 with the condition that he will co-operate with the trial of the case and appear before the investigating officer as and when noticed by him and furnish his mobile number and photocopy of the Aadhar Card with an undertaking that he will not change his mobile number during the pendency of the case and subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) R.K/
